packages.title: Silver Package
packages.priceNote: From $100 per person, based on a small-group itinerary
packages.blurb: Perfect for budget-conscious travelers seeking essential experiences.
packages.overview: Silver is the practical Ceylonix starting point: comfortable transport, standard hotels or guesthouses, and the key stops on a classic Sri Lanka route. It keeps the plan simple so you can see more of the island without paying for extras you may not need.
packages.idealFor: Couples, friends, and first-time visitors who want the main highlights at a sensible cost.
packages.groupStyle: Shared vehicle with other guests when group size allows
included: Standard hotel or guesthouse stays with breakfast
Key destination visits on a set route
Airport pickup and drop-off on tour dates
notIncluded: Entrance tickets to sites and parks
Optional activities such as safari or whale watching
samplePlan: Meet your driver-guide and start the cultural or hill-country route
Visit the main temples, viewpoints, and towns listed in your itinerary
Stay in clean, well-located standard hotels
End with a coastal or city drop-off as planned
packages.tips: Silver works best if you are happy with a shared schedule and standard rooms. Tell us your arrival city so we can fit the route around your flights.

packages.title: Gold Package
packages.priceNote: From $200 per person, with stronger hotels and guiding
packages.blurb: Balanced comfort and experience for a memorable journey.
packages.overview: Gold is the middle path most guests choose. You keep a well-paced itinerary, stay in better hotels, and travel with a more experienced guide. Destinations are curated so the days feel full without being rushed.
packages.idealFor: Families and couples who want comfort, better locations, and a smoother day-to-day plan.
packages.groupStyle: Small group or private vehicle, depending on booking
included: Experienced tour guide throughout the journey
Curated mix of culture, nature, and coast
Enhanced travel comfort and daily briefing
samplePlan: Start with a cultural triangle or Kandy stay in a stronger hotel
Add a hill-country night with a tea-country stop
Include one wildlife or coastal highlight with timed entries
Finish with a quieter beach or Galle Fort evening
packages.tips: Gold is the easiest package to customize. Share any must-see places, walking limits, or family needs when you inquire.

packages.title: Platinum Package
packages.priceNote: From $300 per person, for private luxury travel
packages.blurb: Luxury travel with exclusive experiences and maximum comfort.
packages.overview: Platinum is a private Ceylonix journey: luxury hotels and resorts, a dedicated driver and guide, and an itinerary built around your pace. Days can include exclusive experiences, flexible timing, and VIP handling at key stops.
packages.idealFor: Honeymoons, special occasions, and travellers who want privacy and high-end stays.
packages.groupStyle: Private vehicle, private guide, and private driver
included: Luxury hotels, villas, or resort stays
VIP travel support and priority planning
notIncluded: Premium spa or helicopter add-ons unless requested
Personal shopping and separately booked fine dining
samplePlan: Private arrival handling and a slower first night
Cultural and wildlife days timed around your energy
Optional exclusive add-ons such as balloon, helicopter, or private dining
packages.tips: Platinum works best when we know your travel dates and hotel style early. We then lock rooms and private experiences around that plan.
